marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 1. Friends Forever - Upin Ipin and theirfriends were trapped inside the hut due to heavy rain. Various attempts were made to go home, but failed. At that moment, they started to remember all memories and they were happy to be together until they became good friends.2. Green Leaf - Ros wanted to take care of the body by eating only vegetables. At the same time, Teacher Melati teaches about the benefits of vegetables to Upin and Ipin and friends who do not like to eat vegetables. Upin and Ipin together with Opah and Kak Ros went to the garden and learn about the different types of vegetables and their benefits.
